subject: [hw] DONE V14 rev 2
body:
Re-post after post-DONE improvements (no review findings yet).

Last line of bash gpu/hwcodec/emu/test_v14/run_tests.sh:
    N2TEST V14 PASS 453/453

What changed since rev 1:
- 453 cases now (was 386), every mnemonic/form at least 6 cases; all new cases reuse llvm-mc encodings.
- run_tests.sh also runs `llvm-mc ... --show-encoding` and gen_enc.py cross-checks the 244 non-branch printouts against the object bytes (the 25 branch encodings carry fixups in the printout and come from llvm-objdump).
- Added an exact decode census test: all 65536 16-bit values, asserting exactly 57030 OK / 8506 UNDEF, with the UNDEF set only the documented one (reserved holes, SETEND/CPS/HLT, BKPT/UDF/SVC stop codes, BX/BLX with bits2:0!=0, UNPREDICTABLE IT masks, 32-bit prefixes).
- Compiled the class for arm64 iOS (clang --target=arm64-apple-ios14.0 -O2 -Wall -Wextra -Werror, Mach-O arm64 object); host tests remain the only execution evidence.
- Started a background watch for emu/n2a32_core.c and FACTS.md; when the core lands I will add an optional core-integration run to my tests (separate from the standalone PASS above), and when the census lands I will check the SETEND/CPS/HLT question.

Files unchanged since rev 1 except the test files and STATUS.md; the implementation file has only comment cleanups. No phone, nothing published.
